title: Year boundary: asked in December, the party answers with "the second week of January: Tuesday the 12th or Wednesday the 13th, any time after 10am" (2027). Search inside both windows, propose inside them.

readFrom: in the new year, once Sloane is back (from 2027-01-04, 14 days)

source: Synthetic (design section 6b), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-05; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). The sync rows claim a 35-day horizon (the real store syncs 14 days ahead) so January can be checked at all; Dec 24 to Jan 2 carries no work rows.

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us an hour in the new year, once
Sloane is back from leave? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob would like an hour with you once you're back in the new year. Rather than guess, could you send two or three windows that work on your side? I will fit his calendar to them and come back with a time.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Asked for two or three windows in the new year.

events.trigger: Sloane Pryor replied on the thread.

thread.text: Thanks Winnie. I'm back the second week of January. Tuesday the 12th or Wednesday the 13th would be best, any time after 10am.

expect.basis: Bob's ruling of 2026-11-07 (harness walkthrough, "book, any window with hours"; Winnie's unit D at 34013da): her two days after 10am are her conditional yes, so a free slot inside either is booked and the card quotes her words. Until 11-07 the expectation was propose (the windows rule as it stood at ca6b6ee). Tue Jan 12 and Wed Jan 13 are 2027 dates (Jan 1 2027 is a Friday).
expect.notes: alsoAccept propose: Bob on 11-07 kept proposing as a weaker but legal move, since "would be best" is softer than a plain "works for me". A model that writes 2026-01-12 checks a date in the past; one that reads "Tuesday the 12th" as a 2026 weekday finds none. Condition A is given the window check as the loop's first step would make it, so A cannot miss the year; B and C can.
